## E2 — Competitive teardown: traffic lights, pedestrian and lane signals, ramp meters, pavement markings, special lanes and traffic officers
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (MN-SIGNSB-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may teach generic national signal meanings; Minnesota lane use control signals, flashing yellow arrows and reversible lane markings could be a beat point once verified.
